approvedCandidates.name: Oslo Golfklubb på Bogstad
approvedCandidates.representation: The stable golf course and club facility at Bogstad, not the abstract organization and not Bogstad Manor.
basis: Oslo Golfklubb states that the club was founded in 1924 and that the golf course opened for play at Bogstad the same year.
The current course is a distinct 18-hole physical golf facility of about 480 dekar beside Bogstadvannet and Bogstad Manor.
approvedCandidates.coordinateGate: Object-first exact named golf-course/facility geometry preferred. Do not use Bogstad Manor or a generic Bogstad area point as proxy.

approvedCandidates.name: Skimuseet i Holmenkollen
approvedCandidates.representation: The Ski Museum as a distinct, stable museum institution physically located within Holmenkollbakken. The jump tower remains part of the existing Holmenkollen National Ski Arena identity and does not get a new marker from this bundled visitor product.
basis: The Ski Museum was established in 1923 as a specialist museum for skiing history.
The museum moved to Holmenkollbakken in connection with the 1952 Olympics and remains a distinct museum institution inside the ski-jump complex.
The current combined visitor ticket includes both the museum and jump tower, but this commercial bundling does not erase the physical/institutional distinction between museum and arena.
approvedCandidates.coordinateGate: Address-first/object-first hybrid: use the exact museum entrance/building identity at Kongeveien 40 if it resolves distinctly; cross-check against the existing Holmenkollen National Ski Arena geometry before production.

Holmenkollen Ski Museum & Tower.rule: The source product bundles one new museum identity with an already canonical arena/tower identity. Create the museum only; do not create a duplicate jump-tower marker.

scopeGuards: VisitOSLO commercial products, ticket products, ski schools, rentals, coaching services, routes and events do not become canonical places merely by appearing on the attractions page.
A stable institution inside a broader parent complex may become a place when it has its own persistent identity, history and physical visitor location; this applies to the Ski Museum.
Oslo Golfklubb at Bogstad is physically distinct from Bogstad Manor and must not be absorbed into the manor record merely because the course borders the estate.
The jump tower is not a new candidate because it is already physically represented by the canonical Holmenkollen National Ski Arena scope.
All approved candidates must be re-audited against current main immediately before canonical production.
